choice.title: Veyon Master and Configurator
choice.description: Veyon Master for monitoring and controlling computers, Veyon Configurator and the command line tool veyon-cli.

choice.title: Veyon Service
choice.description: Allows this Mac to be accessed with Veyon Master according to the authentication and access control settings in Veyon Configurator. Required on teacher computers for broadcasting the screen (demo mode). Uses the built-in Screen Sharing of macOS.
